title: Further Expediting of Applications for Financial Assistance under ComCare Schemes
what_it_is: Further Expediting of Applications for Financial Assistance under ComCare Schemes

sections.label: ComCare interim assistance and digitalisation
sections.summary: Social Service Offices provide ComCare Interim Assistance for immediate support while applications are assessed, and ComCare applications have been made simpler through digitalisation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In the interim, if a household requires immediate support, Social Service Offices (SSOs) provide ComCare Interim Assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Time is needed to assess a household’s application for financial assistance, to ensure they meet the eligibility criteria and for proper stewardship of public resources.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: At the same time, we have made ComCare applications simpler and more convenient in recent years through digitalisation.

sections.label: Online application and agency checks
sections.summary: Applicants can apply online at the SupportGoWhere portal using Singpass, but officers still verify documents and may check with other agencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: One way is for them to apply online at the SupportGoWhere portal, where they no longer need to key in all their personal information by using Singpass access and everything that is within that, will already be submitted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Even after that, our officers still need to verify these documents and sometimes, they have to check with other agencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Therefore, when they do this online and get the permission either through online self application or when they meet the clients, we can get information from other agencies like the Central Provident Fund Board, Housing and Development Board, and Immigration and Checkpoints Authority.

sections.label: Silver Generation Ambassadors visits
sections.summary: Silver Generation Ambassadors visit seniors very regularly, sometimes so regularly that the effect on the SGAs is visible when seniors pass on.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Already, our Silver Generation Ambassadors (SGAs) visit them very regularly, some of them, so regularly and getting so intimate that when the seniors pass on, you can see the effect on our SGAs.

sections.label: Proactive referral to SSOs
sections.summary: Through these, they know seniors may lack support and will proactively ask whether they need it and refer them to the SSOs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Through these, they also know that the seniors may not have support or because of changing circumstances may not have support, and therefore, will proactively ask them whether they need it, and then, will refer them to the SSOs.

sections.label: SSO assessment of financial assistance
sections.summary: The SSOs will then take over to check and assess whether seniors actually need the financial assistance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The SSOs will then take over to check and assess whether our seniors are actually really needing the financial assistance.
